        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_job ?= 132 } oe_yv_et_keep = yes debug_log = "oe_yv: .13 b, crown prince designated (if alive at court), El Tegus kept as a prince" }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_job ?= 141 } oe_yv_m6_14a = yes debug_log = "oe_yv: .14 a, Toqto'a resigned (oe_yv_toqto_out 1, divided chancery 5y)" }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_job ?= 142 } oe_yv_m6_14b = yes debug_log = "oe_yv: .14 b, Toqto'a kept as sole chancellor (10y)" }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_job ?= 151 } oe_yv_m6_15a = yes debug_log = "oe_yv: .15 a, Toqto'a to Ganzhou, Hama noted (oe_yv_hama_fav 1)" }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_job ?= 152 } oe_yv_m6_15b = yes debug_log = "oe_yv: .15 b, Majartai and Toqto'a kept at court (oe_yv_toqto_out cleared)" }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_job ?= 161 } oe_yv_m6_16ab = yes debug_log = "oe_yv: .16 a, Toqto'a returns as sole chancellor (5y)" }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_job ?= 162 } oe_yv_m6_16ab = yes debug_log = "oe_yv: .16 b, Toqto'a returns as sole chancellor with posthumous titles (5y)" }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_job ?= 163 } oe_yv_m6_16c = yes debug_log = "oe_yv: .16 c, kept divided chancery (3y), no sole chancellor" }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_job } remove_variable = oe_yv_job }
    }
}

# Hidden, 31 days after event 13 option a (oe_yv_et_exile): El Tegus dies on the road into exile (history: edict
# 1340-07-09, death 1340-08-09). Silent, as Bayan's death in oe_yv_ev_monthly; the option's tooltip announced it.
oe_yv.21 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_yv.21.t
    trigger = { tag = CHI }
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = { character:oe_s37_el_tegus ?= { is_alive = yes has_variable = oe_yv_exiled } }
            kill_character_silently = { target = character:oe_s37_el_tegus }
            debug_log = "oe_yv: .21 El Tegus died on the road into exile"
        }
    }
}
